Name: Curses Of The Valley
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Now I thought the Statue of Blessings was lacking... But instead of making it better, what if it made your life even worse? Because... why not I guess. Who [i]doesn't[/i] like to struggle. 

Using the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25267]Custom Blessings Framework[/url] I added 10 curses to the game just to make life that much more difficult. Because investing all of those items into the statue just to be cursed is very 'fun.'

They are all essentially opposites of my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25301]Blessings[/url] mod - which I highly recommend since I imagine having just curses would kinda suck (The framework this mod uses removes the vanilla ones unless they are manually added. My blessings mod also includes the vanilla ones plus the 10 I made. This one only includes curses.) 


Spoiler for the curses:

[spoiler]Curse Of The Spirits: -2 Luck
Curse Of The Siren: -2 Fishing
Curse Of Nature: -3 Foraging
Curse Of Repulsion: -100 Magnetism
Curse Of The Caverns: -3 Mining
Curse Of Famine: -4 Farming
Curse Of Vulnerability: -2 Defense
Curse Of The Pacifist: -45 Max Stamina, -1 Defense, -3 Attack. -2 Combat
Curse Of The Earth: -1 Luck, -2 Farming, -2 Foraging
Curse Of The Hurricane: -1 Speed
[/spoiler]



Notes:
- If you have any suggestions (either for better balance or for more to add) let me know!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
